scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend

scripts.docker:test: docker compose run --rm backend npm run test
